sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; return (min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def nrow(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=36: out.append((min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
# clear the 3 N tiles in player row band (rows 37-41)
for (r,c) in [(39,27),(39,21),(39,15)]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(f"MOUSE({r},{c}): Nrow={nrow(current_frame)}")
# now move LEFT
for i in range(5):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"L{i+1}: player={ppos(current_frame)}")
print("final player",ppos(current_frame),"Nrow",nrow(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
